purpose: Make the resource burden of an AI mobility service visible before any pilot, procurement or scale-up decision.
boundary: This is a design ledger. It does not measure local electricity, fuel, staffing, equipment, vendor performance, emissions, cost or public acceptance.

compute_and_network.control_zh: 记录模型调用、网络与边缘设备；合成 PASS 不得自动扩容
compute_and_network.control_en: Record model calls, network and edge devices; a synthetic PASS cannot scale service.
compute_and_network.evidence_required_zh: 按场景记录日期、调用量、延迟、设备和非 AI 等价路径
compute_and_network.evidence_required_en: Dated calls, latency, devices and a non-AI equivalent path by scenario.

energy_and_fuel.control_zh: 没有计量边界，不报 kWh、燃料、碳排或节能
energy_and_fuel.control_en: Without a metering boundary, report no kWh, fuel, carbon or savings.
energy_and_fuel.evidence_required_zh: 地铁、公交、班车、汽车与设备的有日期计量边界
energy_and_fuel.evidence_required_en: Dated accounting boundaries for rail, bus, shuttle, car and equipment.

physical_devices.control_zh: 设备必须可撤回、有资产 ID、维护人和回收去向
physical_devices.control_en: Devices must be removable, identified, maintained and assigned a return path.
physical_devices.evidence_required_zh: 闸机、信息牌、传感器、充电与可移动设施清单
physical_devices.evidence_required_en: Inventories for gates, signs, sensors, charging and removable kit.

data_and_privacy.control_zh: 只保留分组聚合；目的、保留、删除和申诉责任先公开
data_and_privacy.control_en: Retain grouped aggregates only; publish purpose, retention, deletion and appeal ownership.
data_and_privacy.evidence_required_zh: 同意、分组阈值、保留周期、删除日志和人工入口
data_and_privacy.evidence_required_en: Consent, group thresholds, retention, deletion logs and human entry.

human_review.control_zh: 每个自动建议都有人工、电话和纸面等价服务
human_review.control_en: Every automated suggestion keeps a human, telephone and paper equivalent.
human_review.evidence_required_zh: 复核分钟数、值守角色、拒绝权、申诉与无障碍服务记录
human_review.evidence_required_en: Review minutes, staffed roles, veto, appeal and accessibility records.

supplier_and_maintenance.control_zh: 没有具名运营、维护 SLA 和供应商退出路径，不进入扩展
supplier_and_maintenance.control_en: No expansion without a named operator, maintenance SLA and supplier exit path.
supplier_and_maintenance.evidence_required_zh: 责任矩阵、巡检、故障响应、供应商替代和保险接口
supplier_and_maintenance.evidence_required_en: RACI, inspections, incident response, vendor substitution and insurance interface.

failure_and_exit.control_zh: 先写停机、回退、拆除、恢复公共路线和投诉关闭动作
failure_and_exit.control_en: Define stop, rollback, removal, public-route restoration and complaint closure first.
failure_and_exit.evidence_required_zh: 触发条件、撤回工时、存储/拆除、恢复和复盘记录
failure_and_exit.evidence_required_en: Triggers, withdrawal labour, storage/removal, restoration and review records.

scenario_cards.resource_focus_zh: 班次、车队、调度与公共交通替代
scenario_cards.resource_focus_en: headways, fleet, dispatch and public-transport alternative
scenario_cards.fallback_zh: 人工调度 + 地铁/公交

scenario_cards.resource_focus_zh: 数据最小化、人工办理与公平入口
scenario_cards.resource_focus_en: data minimisation, human processing and equal entry

scenario_cards.resource_focus_zh: 夜间值守、照明、班车和人工兜底
scenario_cards.resource_focus_en: night staffing, lighting, shuttle and human fallback
scenario_cards.fallback_zh: 人工确认 + 公共交通

scenario_cards.resource_focus_zh: 路缘设备、维护、清场和投诉闭环
scenario_cards.resource_focus_en: curb equipment, maintenance, clearing and complaints
scenario_cards.fallback_zh: 暂停预约 + 人工装卸

scenario_cards.resource_focus_zh: 照护人员、无障碍车辆和非 App 入口
scenario_cards.resource_focus_en: carers, accessible vehicles and non-app entry

scenario_cards.resource_focus_zh: 连续坡道、人工引导和恢复公共路径
scenario_cards.resource_focus_en: continuous ramps, human guidance and route restoration
scenario_cards.fallback_zh: 人工带行 + 公共路线

scenario_cards.resource_focus_zh: 站口信息、照明、候车和步行/骑行替代
scenario_cards.resource_focus_en: station information, lighting, waiting and walk/cycle alternatives
scenario_cards.fallback_zh: 人工指引 + 步行/公交

scenario_cards.resource_focus_zh: 临时设施、消防净空、人员复核和拆除
scenario_cards.resource_focus_en: temporary kit, fire clearance, human review and removal
scenario_cards.fallback_zh: 停止自动分流 + 人工管控

scenario_cards.resource_focus_zh: 能源、通信、人工值守和回滚存储
scenario_cards.resource_focus_en: energy, communications, staffing and rollback storage
scenario_cards.fallback_zh: 冻结预约 + 人工/公交

scenario_cards.resource_focus_zh: 责任人、维修耗材、数据删除与复盘

no_go_gates.label_zh: 无人工/公共交通等价路径
设备或供应商无维护退出路径
no_go_gates.label_en: no device or supplier exit path

no_go_gates.label_zh: 消防、无障碍或安静界面受损
no_go_gates.label_en: fire, accessibility or quiet interface harmed

no_go_gates.label_zh: 失败、拆除和公共路线恢复未登记
no_go_gates.label_en: failure, removal and public-route restoration unregistered

interpretation: The passport prevents a synthetic mobility score from hiding the resources and responsibilities required by an AI service. Every real measurement, approval and operating result remains unknown until dated evidence exists.
